posts.title: Collaborative editor for humans and AI Agents
posts.description: I built pad to co-edit a document with several AI agents inside the file I have open in Kiro. The agents read the editor buffer and write into it by anchor, so their edits land in the text while I keep typing, without a save step and without conflicts on line numbers. posts.title: You can shape your Internet content
posts.description: User interfaces feel a bit hostile at times, but we can now shape the content we consume in ways we couldn’t before. For the last ten or twenty years software has consolidated into a handful of big vendors, and somewhere along the way the user stopped mattering much.
